text:
Jordan: Hey team — noticed my last paycheck didn’t include the OT from 4/12–4/18 and the state withholding looks like it was calculated for CA even though I switched my home address to OR on 4/10. Can someone check?

Maya (Payroll): Sorry, Jordan. I can look. Can you drop a screenshot of the paystub line and confirm the pay period and your current state on file?

Jordan: pay period 2024-04-12 to 2024-04-18. Screenshot: https://files.redwood.internal/paystubs/jordan-0418.png — shows "Base: 40.00 hrs" and no OT line. Home address on file updated to OR (moved 4/10).

Liam (People Ops): @Maya fyi we processed the HR address change on 4/11 at 09:12. I'll attach the change log.

Maya (Payroll): Thanks. Two likely issues: 1) paycode for OT wasn't applied when the timesheet override happened, 2) state tax mapping didn't re-run for that pay run after the address update. I'll open a ticket and run a manual reprocess.

PayrollBot: Ticket #PR-2024-789 opened by Maya. Status: triage. ETA initial triage: 2 business hours.

Nicole (Manager): @Jordan sorry about the gap. If this is blocking you, we can do a manual off-cycle for the OT portion while payroll fixes the state withholding. Would that help?

Jordan: Yes please — off-cycle would be great. Also want to confirm whether the state withholding correction will require a W-2 adjustment or just a retro tax correction on next regular run.

Maya (Payroll): We'll aim for two things: 1) off-cycle check for OT (gross only) today and 2) re-calc state withholding retroactively. If tax tables differ materially we'll issue a W-2 correction (W-2C) for the year — but we won't know until the re-calc. I'll update ticket with outcomes.

Liam (People Ops): Quick note on process for auditors: whenever a home-state changes mid-pay-period we add a residency memo to the payroll run. Maya — can you attach the residency memo to PR-2024-789?

Maya (Payroll): Yep, memo attached. Also copying the timesheet override log:

```
Timesheet override: user=jordan, run_by=nicole, date=2024-04-15T08:04Z, original_hours=48, adjusted_hours=44, reason="PTO coding fix"
Payroll job: run_id=payrun-20240418-03, processed_at=2024-04-19T06:30Z, state_map=CA (initial), state_map_updated=OR (applied 2024-04-19T07:45Z)
```

PayrollBot: PR-2024-789 updated: Off-cycle check queued. Estimated off-cycle payout: 2024-04-22.

Jordan: Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. Please ping me when the off-cycle posts so I can confirm net pay.

Nicole (Manager): tagging for visibility: @people-ops leadership — FYI recurring issue when we do mid-period address updates + timesheet overrides. Might be worth a short doc on sequencing to avoid double-processing. :thinking_face:

Maya (Payroll): Agreed — I'll draft a one-pager with the recommended sequence: update HR address before final timesheet lock, run state map sync, then close overrides. Will share in #people-ops after PR-2024-789 resolves.

PayrollBot: PR-2024-789 status -> in_progress. Last update: 2024-04-21T14:02Z.

Jordan: confirmed off-cycle posted today (2024-04-22). OT showed up as "Overtime (4/12-4/18) 4.0 hrs x $48 = $192". State withholding recalculated for OR and net looks right. Thanks @Maya and team. :relieved:

Maya (Payroll): Great — closing the ticket. We'll monitor for any W-2 impacts and will follow up if a W-2C is required.

PayrollBot: PR-2024-789 closed by Maya on 2024-04-22T17:05Z.
